Subject: Need help with a land dispute case

Hello, my name is Simran Reddy. I am a 34-year-old chartered accountant living in Thiruvananthapuram. I have a land dispute with Simran Bose over land worth ₹1,56,00,000, and relatives dispute who owns the ancestral land. My case number is R.C.S. No. 33/2020 in the Thiruvananthapuram District Court. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on 80894 85900 or email simran.reddy12@example.com.
